But Republicans have spent big there, too, to try and maintain that seat.
Stephen Fowler, NPR News, Little Rock, Arkansas.
Alaska Democratic Senate candidate Mary Peltola is suspending campaign events today and tomorrow.
After suffering what her campaign calls minor injuries in a car accident,
the required medical attention.

It also says Peltola and her family sustained minor injuries,

This is the Justice Department is suing to block certification

Polls to elect a new president are now closed in Brazil.
Voters are choosing between the long-time leftist leader
or the son of a former far-right president.
As NPR's Carrie Khan reports, a loss by Luis Inazio Lula da Silva
would be the latest and largest shift to the right in Latin America.
President Lula has been fighting hard in the closing weeks of his last election in Brazil.
Now 80 the icon of Latin America's left trailed in the second round behind Flavio Bolsonaro.
He's the son of Lula's longtime political rival,
Jair Bolsonaro, who is currently under house arrest for plotting a coup.
Speaking to reporters before voting Sunday,
Lula said he has never seen anything like the mobilization of his supporters
in the final days of the campaign.
Almost inexplicable, he said.
Bolsonaro pledges to free his father if elected

Carrie Khan, NPR News, Brasilia.
